SELECT toString(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Shanghai')) AS t,
       event,
       coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.raw_params),''),'') AS raw_params,
       toString(properties.$source) AS src,
       toString(properties.advertiser_name) AS advertiser
FROM events WHERE coalesce(properties.$geoip_country_code,'') != 'CN'
  AND (person_id IS NULL OR toString(person_id) NOT IN ('8435b8d5-16b6-5f4b-9b71-f5d4d196ad00','83b89204-633d-56fa-9e65-202e62d839ff','259d7d34-120f-50a6-a260-3e7fa192ae79','8b444548-d415-5d49-88b2-f717feaba288','b7575d9c-8453-5600-874a-47188ad98ec8','01a0b5bc-770d-7c62-b34d-5416ccb6f386'))
  AND (event='Order_Converted' OR event LIKE '%Postback%')
  AND timestamp >= toDateTime(1787932800) AND timestamp < toDateTime(1790594114)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
